design: Authored scripted comparison; outcomes are scenario fixtures, not measured customer responses.
persona: A refurbishment operations lead who previously experienced a failed ERP integration
need: QR repair history, private owner information, and validated ERP integration
objection: The last vendor overpromised. Why should I trust your ERP integration?

strategies.name: Universal promise
strategies.pitch: We integrate with every ERP. Every partner sees the complete device history.

strategies.name: Scoped validation
strategies.pitch: ERP integration depends on API compatibility and sandbox validation. Partners see assigned records and owner personal details remain hidden. Which ERP version do you use?

runs.quote: Every ERP? Does that include our old version without an API?
You have not explained how owner information stays private.
That sounds like the same promise the previous vendor made.
A sandbox check makes sense. I can share our ERP version.
Which sample partner accounts should we use for privacy testing?
Let us agree on the validation criteria before we commit.

caveat: Six authored runs, three per strategy, with the same persona and objection. No randomisation, independent observations, causal inference or real-world conversion claim. This demonstrates the comparison mechanism only.
